decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9695. Series context: trend strength 0.9656 and seasonal strength 0.8262; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.322); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.969.
